company: CTW (formerly CTW Cayman; G123.jp anime-IP browser-game platform, Tokyo; Nasdaq foreign private issuer, semi-annual reporter)
conviction_note: Nothing decisive was found. A yen about 7% weaker over the half and a tough +41% comparison lean the second-half revenue line toward a year-on-year decline. Against that, three titles launched in the half (Kakegurui ALL IN, HSOTD Day 0 and The Apothecary Diaries on 2026-06-15), and the first half held revenue flat on 24% less advertising. The stock has also fallen on every company release since June, so low expectations are already in the price. With no consensus, no options and two prior reactions (+9.33%, -0.34%), p_up sits at 48 on a wide 8.5% abs move, and the per-finding sum (-0.2) and the scaled number (-0.34) agree.
bar: No sourced consensus. Coverage is one Weiss 'Sell' rating with no estimates (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/CTW/forecast/, read 2026-10-15). A search snippet credits Seeking Alpha/Benzinga with a FY26 EPS consensus of $0.09, but it is a single unverified source (Benzinga returned 403), likely stale from before 1H, and implies about +$0.11 in 2H after a -$0.02 1H. It is disowned and anchors nothing. The working bar is last year's comparison: 2H FY25 revenue of about $49.2M (FY25 $90.4M less 1H25 $41.2M; +41% YoY), 2H25 net income $3.2M and 2H25 adjusted EBITDA about $4.26M (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/CTW/ctw-announces-fiscal-year-2025-financial-5bncyokzbxna.html), against the FY25 record of $90.4M. The company gives no numeric guidance (https://finviz.com/news/353800/ctw-announces-financial-results-for-first-half-of-fiscal-2026). Because the bar is unsourced, every size is capped small. print_vs_bar_pct is 2H revenue against the 2H25 $49.2M comparison.
positioning_check: Short interest is about 35k shares, roughly 0.1% of shares outstanding, with 1.63 days to cover (Equibles, settlement 2026-05-29, https://equibles.com/stocks/ctw/short-interest, via the sweep row), so it is not a crowded short. The float is tiny, about 2.40M shares of roughly 62M outstanding (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/CTW/), and turnover is about $35k a day (baseline avg_volume_20d 16,060 at $2.20). There is no option market (baseline options.status no_options_market), so there is no skew. The tape reads 5d -4.35%, 20d -5.58%, -26.9% from the 52-week high and +81.8% from the 52-week low, with 20d realised vol at 101.5% annualised. The stock fell on every company release from June to September: 06-11 -2.8%, 08-03 -4.03%, 08-27 -6.64%, 09-03 -4.84%, 09-16 -2.59%. It rose +3.45% on the 10-05 date announcement (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/CTW/). Insiders: only a CFO option grant (100k options at $2.48, 2026-08-07, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2047148/000121390026087592/0001213900-26-087592.txt) and a CTO exercise-and-sell of 669 shares in May, which carry no signal.

findings.finding: The yen was about 7% weaker against the dollar over CTW's second half (Feb-Jul 2026) than over the same months of 2025. Month-end USD/JPY averaged about 158.4 (156.1, 158.7, 156.6, 159.3, 162.6, 157.4) against about 147.1 (150.6, 150.0, 143.1, 144.1, 144.0, 150.8). Japan is 68.4% of revenue and CTW reports in USD, so translation alone takes roughly 4.5-5% off reported 2H revenue. The comparison is 2H FY25 at about $49.2M, which grew 41% YoY. A flat-in-yen half therefore prints about $47M and full-year FY26 about $88M, against the $90.4M FY25 record.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There are two observed reactions to results. FY25 (record revenue +32%, 2H +41%), released 2025-11-17 at 16:30 ET, rose +9.33% on 2025-11-18. 1H FY26 (revenue -1%, adjusted EBITDA +16%), released 2026-05-13 at 07:00, moved -0.34% that day. No reaction to a revenue decline has been observed.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody publishes a 2H revenue estimate for this name: no analyst models it, there are no options, and turnover is $35k a day, so no number carries the FX translation through to CTW's USD revenue line. If it were priced, a sourced estimate would sit below $49M, or the company would have flagged FX. Neither exists. The stock's drift down since June is consistent with a weak-half expectation, so part of this may already be in the price.
findings.independence: This is a macro-to-company proxy that the company has not confirmed. The 2025 month-end rates come from https://www.poundsterlinglive.com/history/USD-JPY-2025, the same provider. The 68.4% Japan revenue share comes from the 1H FY26 MD&A (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2047148/000121390026055850/ea028999901ex99-1.htm).

findings.finding: Three titles launched in the half under report, with company-stated traction: Kakegurui ALL IN (2026-03-23, stock +12.3% that day), HIGH SCHOOL OF THE DEAD DAY 0 (April 2026, 'already seeing strong user growth') and The Apothecary Diaries Palace Chronicles (2026-06-15, over 200,000 pre-registrations). This follows a first half in which revenue held at $40.9M (-1%) while advertising spend fell 23.9% ($24.7M to $18.8M). Paying MAU held at 75.7k against 76.7k despite MAU falling 39%, so the revenue base is sticky and the new titles add on top of it. Each launch got only part of the half: Apothecary had about six weeks.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Title news has moved the stock more than results. The Kakegurui launch release rose +12.3% (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/CTW/ctw-launches-kakegurui-all-in-advancing-its-pipeline-of-additional-00zd9n8s3f22.html). The 1H release showed revenue -1% with profit up and moved -0.34%. FY25, with seven launches producing $32.3M, rose +9.33%.
findings.why_not_priced: No quantity has been disclosed for any of the 2H titles. 'Strong user growth' carries no number, and the market has fallen on every release since June, including -4.84% on this one. If title traction were priced, the stock would not be at -27% from its high on a 20d of -5.6%. The question is whether the titles offset the FX and comparison headwinds, and nothing public answers it.
findings.independence: The 1H ad-spend and paying-MAU figures come from a different document, the 1H FY26 MD&A (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2047148/000121390026055850/ea028999901ex99-1.htm, 2026-05-13). The Apothecary launch date is from gamebiz (https://gamebiz.jp/news/427812, 2026-06-15). All of these are company-sourced, with no third-party revenue data.

findings.finding: The year-on-year profit comparison is tough and partly optical. 2H FY25 carried net income of $3.2M and adjusted EBITDA of about $4.26M, and FY25's $3.8M net income included a non-recurring $4.7M contingent gain on recovery of a previously impaired asset (MTGOX). 1H FY26 posted a $1.2M net loss. FY26 net income is therefore very likely to print below FY25's, even if operations improve, and a headline 'net loss for the year' is plausible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In 1H FY26 net income swung from +$0.6M to -$1.2M while adjusted EBITDA rose 16%, and the stock moved -0.34% (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/CTW/). The holders looked through the net loss once.
findings.why_not_priced: The one-off is disclosed, so anyone reading the FY25 release knows the comparison is inflated, and this is mostly priced. What is unpriced is how the headline FY-on-FY net income comparison reads on wire summaries on a name with no analyst to frame it. The one-off sits in the comparison and does not change the operating line, so the finding is small.
findings.independence: The 1H net loss comes from the 1H release (https://finviz.com/news/353800/ctw-announces-financial-results-for-first-half-of-fiscal-2026). The MTGOX detail is from a search summary of the FY25 6-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2047148/000121390025111570/ea026595301ex99-1_ctwcayman.htm). The FY25 figures share a document with the bar.

findings.finding: The stock fell on every company release from June to September (06-11 -2.8%, 08-03 -4.03%, 08-27 -6.64%, 09-03 -4.84%, 09-16 -2.59%), then rose +3.45% on the 10-05 results-date notice. It sits -27% from its 52-week high and -5.6% over 20 days. The float is about 2.4M of 62M shares, short interest about 0.1%, and turnover about $35k a day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior instance of a results print after a drawdown of this length. FY25 rose +9.33% the day after a record-revenue release.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the price itself, so by definition it is priced. It is filed because, on a $35k-a-day name with a 2.4M float, a drawdown into the print means the marginal seller has already sold, so a merely in-line print has room to bounce. The drawdown has no identified cause, so it is sized near zero.
findings.independence: Quantisnow shows the 1-month change at -7.41% and 42-day average short volume at 41% (https://www.quantisnow.com/company/CTW). This is the same tape, not an independent source.

findings.finding: After the period, Similarweb's September 2026 estimate has g123.jp traffic down 7.58% month on month. Its global rank slipped from #4,897 to #5,123 over three months, with about 17.7M visits over three months (#650 in Japan). This is weak post-period engagement that would feed any first-quarter FY27 commentary on the webinar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The company has never given numeric guidance. No reaction to outlook commentary has been isolated, and the 1H 'fell short of expectations' language moved -0.34%.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody covering this stock reads web-traffic panels, and the company gives no current-quarter KPIs. If it were priced it would show up as a guided-down outlook or analyst commentary, and neither exists. It is a third-party estimate, traffic does not equal paying users (paying MAU was flat while MAU fell 39% in 1H), and it is post-period, so it is small.
findings.independence: None directly. An older Semrush page (https://tr.semrush.com/website/g123.jp/overview) carries an undated, probably 2025, series on a different methodology and is not comparable.

findings.finding: The pipeline kept moving after the period ended: Shakugan no Shana Blaze Edge launched on 2026-09-14, an original title, Sai Magic, opened pre-registration on 2026-09-23, and Skeleton Knight SKULL BRAVE is in pre-registration. Management has material for a first-quarter FY27 narrative of new launches at the webinar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last title-launch release (Kakegurui, 2026-03-23) rose +12.3%. The pipeline-update release of 2026-09-03 fell -4.84%.
findings.source_date: 2026-06-15 (page lists related CTW items dated 2026-09-11, 09-14 and 09-23)
findings.why_not_priced: These launches were announced in the Japanese trade press (gamebiz), not on the US wire, which carried no CTW title release after March. They are public, so the case for being unpriced is weak, and the finding is small.
findings.independence: The Skeleton Knight pre-registration is in the 2026-09-03 company release (https://finviz.com/news/388664/ctw-expands-us-engagement-and-highlights-growing-pipeline-of-anime-ip-based-browser-games).

rejected_candidates.detail: Search snippet only. The Benzinga page returned 403 and MarketBeat shows no estimates, so the number could not be verified and is probably stale from before 1H. The bar is treated as unsourced.
The fetched page shows $2.44, -2.60% on 2026-10-14, and the sealed baseline spot is $2.20. The snippet is a stale quote, not a current move.

baseline_tension: There is no skew or option anchor to cut against. The mild negative lean from FX and the comparison agrees with the 20-day drift down, so it is probably partly priced, which keeps p_up near 50 (48) rather than lower.
lessons_applied: Lesson 5 (an unexplained microcap drawdown is worth 0): the positioning/drawdown finding was cut from +0.5 to +0.1, not dropped
Lesson 5 (macro-to-company transmission is filed small): the FX translation finding was cut from -0.8 to -0.6, and the traffic proxy from -0.4 to -0.3
Lesson 2 (one-offs are one-offs): the MTGOX-inflated net income comparison was cut from -0.5 to -0.3, since it moves no operating line
Lesson 6 (unsourced bar): the SA $0.09 EPS was disowned and moved to rejected, and all sizes stay capped small
Lesson 8 (thin coverage): abs_move_pct was raised from 8.0 to 8.5 for the 2.4M float and $35k a day of turnover, with no confirmed unpriced number to enlarge any finding
Lesson 7: short interest was checked (0.1%, 1.63 days to cover), so it is not crowded and the small negatives were not shrunk further for it
